description_sq:
Shitet, Apartament 2+1+2tualete+Blk, Stacioni i Trenit, 218.000 Euro
Karakteristikat e prones:
– Apartament 2+1
– Rruga Hysen Dalliu
– Tek Prokuroria e Tiranes
– Kati 7, pallat me ashensor
– Siperfaqja bruto 93m²
– Siperfaqja neto 83m²
– Cmimi 218.000 Euro
Shitet apartament 2+1 me siperfaqe 93m², i cili ndodhet ne katin e 7 te nje pallati te ri me ashensor tek Rruga Hysen Dalliu, Prane Prokurorise se Tiranes. Apartamenti organizohet ne sallon ndenje, ambient gatimi, 2 dhoma gjumi me kondicioner te rinj secila, ballkoni dhe dy tualete me dritare. I sapo restauruar me punime extra, jo te firmes. Kjo prone eshte nje mundesi e mire per jetes komode por dhe per investim (qera & Airbnb). Orientimi Lindje-Perendim, pra ka drite natyrale gjate gjithe dites. Gati per mobilim!!!
Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion të rregullt hipotekor.
Ndodhet ne nje zone e cila i ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme dhe eshte vtem 7 MINUTA larg Qendres se Tiranes.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare!
title_en: For sale, Apartment 2+1+2toilet+Blk, Train Station, 218.000 Euro
description_en: For sale, Apartment 2+1+2toilet+Blk, Train Station, 218,000 Euro Property features: – Apartment 2+1 – Hysen Dalliu Street – At the Prosecutor's Office of Tirana – Floor 7, building with elevator – Gross area 93m² – Net area 83m² – Price 218,000 Euro 2+1 apartment for sale 93m², which is located on the 7th floor of a new building with an elevator on Rruga Hysen Dalliu, near the Prosecutor's Office of Tirana. The apartment is organized in living room, kitchen area, 2 bedrooms with new air conditioners each, balcony and two bathrooms with windows. Newly restored with extra work, not by the company. This property is a good opportunity for comfortable living but also for investment (rental & Airbnb). East-West orientation, so there is natural light throughout the day. Ready for furnishing!!! The apartment has regular mortgage documentation. It is located in an area that offers all the necessary facilities and is only 7 MINUTES away from the Center of Tirana. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency!
